LEGACY_PLANT_CD mapping in legacy root view: Join IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_TRN_ITEM_RESERVATION_LEGACY_ROOT RESB_LEGACY with IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_PLANT_CODE_MAPPING_CORE_PIT PLANT_MAPPING based on RESB_LEGACY.PLANT_CD and PLANT_MAPPING.LEGACY_PLANT_CD and get the PLANT_MAPPING.PLANT_CD as PLANT_CD in the dataset of view V_TRN_ITEM_RESERVATION_LEGACY_ROOT.
2. From the IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.V_TRN_ITEM_RESERVATION_ROOT and IF_SUPPLY_CHAIN.PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.V_TRN_ITEM_RESERVATION_LEGACY_ROOT, remove leading zeroes from ITEM_ID. 
3. Perform Union on the RESB root view and RESB_LEGACY root view to get the final stage view.
